Jordan: Who's up for a hike Saturday morning? Planning to hit Mount Lark trail. Leaving 8am. Pancakes afterwards? :pancakes:
Priya: I'm in for pancakes but can only do Sunday morning :wave:
Eli: If you go Saturday I can tag along til noon. Also gonna try the sourdough pancake recipe from @Tess — here's the link: http://example.com/pancake-recipe
Tess: That recipe is 🔥 — pro tip: rest the batter 30 mins. Quick mix: ```1 cup flour
1 egg
1 cup milk
1 tsp baking powder
mix```
Jordan: Nice, we can split groups. @Priya Sunday crew, @Eli you Saturday. Anyone need a ride from SOMA?
Deepa: Leaving from SOMA, I can take 2. @Jordan ping me details. Also bringing a portable speaker :notes:
ops-bot: Reminder: patio chairs return due Monday (office event).
Eli: :raised_hands: @Deepa that'd be awesome. I can bring coffee in a thermos ☕
Priya: Sunday brunch works. Count me in for 10am pancakes at The Hollow.
Jordan: Cool — I'll create a tiny poll in #lunch-plans; otherwise meet at 8 at 16th & Folsom for the hike. Happy weekend y'all :sunglasses:
